myJournalHint: Your personal journal of accomplishments — what happened, what you contributed, why it mattered, and what backs it up. Your managers can read it; only you write it.
managedHint: The journals of the people who report to you — read-only. The Reports filter can widen the list to your whole management chain.
loadListError: Failed to load the impact log
title: Title
createHint: Record an accomplishment: the period it covers and the four sections below. Your direct managers will be notified.
deleteConfirmMessage: Delete "{{title}}"? Its content will no longer be readable.
discardCreateMessage: Discard this journal entry? Anything you've written won't be saved.
discardChangesMessage: Discard your changes? The entry will remain as it was.

validation.periodOrder: Period start must not be after its end

error.permission: Only the journal's owner may change this entry.
error.invalid: The entry is invalid — check the period and the four sections.
error.saveFailed: Failed to save the entry. Please try again.
error.viewPermission: You don't have access to this entry.

journalAuditHint: The auditor view: {{who}}'s whole journal, read-only. Access is recorded in the security audit trail.
reviewHint: Read your entry over — you can still step back and change any section.
